title: bidens pilosa subvar. radiata
intro: Bidens pilosa subvar. radiata, commonly known as small bur marigold or Thai beggar's tick, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Bidens pilosa subvar. radiata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in this plant work together to exhibit its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
